verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an identity platform, and a SaaS platform could plausibly ship background automation or workflow features, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent pieces. Actions are Node.js functions that customize login and identity flows. The CLI can 'automate tasks' as a developer building block. CIBA and Token Vault are primitives for customers' own agents. None of these is a documented, product-provided way for a user to set up automations that run autonomously or on a schedule in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
